titles.romaji: Souryo to Majiwaru Shikiyoku no Yoru ni...
titles.english: On a Lustful Night Mingling with a Priest
titles.native: 僧侶と交わる色欲の夜に...

description:
The story begins when a woman reunites with her first love at a class reunion. She discovers that Kujou has taken over his family's temple as a priest. The woman thought that priests did not have romantic relationships, but a passion ignites between the two. She wonders if what she and the priest do is really right.

(Source: Anime News Network)
